body.p: This listing of the claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claim in the present application.

br.br:
1. (Currently amended) A manipulating device, comprising:
a rocker (1), one end of the rocker (1) is a manipulation end, another end of the rocker (4- is provided with a magnetic assembly (3), and the rocker (1) is configured to be rotatable; and
a coil assembly (4) disposed opposite to the rocker (1) and adjacent to the magnetic assembly (3), wherein the magnetic assembly (3) comprises a central magnet (31) and at least one side magnets (32), and the coil assembly (4) is configured to be capable of being supplied with an electrical signal, and an interaction force is generated between the coil assembly (1) and the magnetic assembly (3).
2. (Currently amended) The manipulating device according to claim 1, wherein the central magnet (31) is formed to have a column shape, and one end of the central magnet (31) having the cylinder shape is fixedly connected to the rocker (1).
3. (Currently amended) The manipulating device according to claim 2, wherein another end of the central magnet (31) having the column shape is formed to have a spherical surface.
4. (Currently amended) The manipulating device according to claim 1, wherein a magnetization direction of the central magnet (31) is parallel to an axial direction of the central magnet (31) having the column shape, and a magnetization direction of the side magnet (32) is perpendicular to the axial direction of the central magnet (31) having the column shape.
5. (Currently amended) The manipulating device according to claim 1, further comprises a supporting member (2), and the rocker (1) is rotatable around the supporting member (2).
6. (Currently amended) The manipulating device according to claim 1, further comprises a housing, and both the supporting member (2) and the coil assembly (4) are fixedly connected to the housing.
7. (Currently amended) The manipulating device according to claim 1, further comprises a fitting member (5), wherein the fitting member (5) is a magnet, and the magnet is positioned in the middle of the coil assembly (1).
8. (Currently amended) The manipulating device according to claim 1, further comprises a fitting member (5), the fitting member (5) is an iron core, and the iron core is positioned in the middle of the coil assembly (1).
9. (Currently amended) A manipulating device according to claim 1, wherein a central axis of the coil assembly (4) passes through a center around which the rocker (1) rotates.
10. (Currently amended) A manipulating device according to claim 1, wherein the rocker (1) is symmetrically disposed with respect to an A-A plane.
